description:
## Problem

`app.model.select` (`ctrl+l`) is dispatched in `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` at lines 1232-1234, but no model selector component exists, so the action is a no-op. Verified in tmux: pressing `ctrl+l` produces no visible UI.

## Upstream component

`tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/components/model-selector.ts`. Activated via `showModelSelector(initialSearchInput?)` (`interactive-mode.ts:3924-`). Mounted via `showSelector` modal pattern (`interactive-mode.ts:3682-3693`).

## Bindings consumed

Standard `tui.select.*` only — no model-selector-specific bindings beyond the search input. The search input itself uses standard `tui.editor.*` cursor/deletion/yank actions (per the `Input` component reuse pattern).

## Behavior

1. Selector lists all configured models with a search input at top.
2. Filter by typing.
3. `enter` selects → calls `session.setModel(modelId)`, shows status `"Switched to {modelName}"`.
4. `escape` / `ctrl+c` (with empty search) cancels without changing model.
5. After selection, also invalidates footer + updates editor border color (border tracks current thinking level).

## Files likely created/modified

- New: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/model_selector.ex`.
- Update: `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` to call `show_model_selector/0` instead of the current no-op.

## Acceptance

- `ctrl+l` opens the selector with search input focused.
- Typing filters the model list.
- Enter sets the active model and closes the selector with a status message.
- Escape cancels.
- Footer updates to reflect new model.

## Notes

Smaller than the tree/session/scoped-models selectors because there are no selector-specific app actions — just standard `tui.select.*` flow. This mostly exercises the modal pattern correctly. If the modal infrastructure isn't yet in place in octo_pi, that surfaces as a prerequisite (likely shared with the other selector tickets).
title: Model selector activation (ctrl+l)
